title: Illumi Crushes Killua With Psychological Terror

cuts.voiceover_text: A deadly assassin reaches his breaking point when forced to choose between his family and his first real friend. Killua stands in the arena, openly defying his terrifying older brother, Illumi. He shouts that he is sick of killing and desperate for a normal friendship with Gon. Killua's voice trembles with raw emotion. But Illumi stares back with pitch-black, lifeless eyes. He coldly dismisses Killua's plea as impossible.

When Leorio shouts from the sidelines that Gon already considers him a true friend, the danger instantly escalates. Illumi tilts his head, alarmed by the boy's influence. Without showing a hint of hesitation, Illumi calmly resolves to assassinate Gon immediately. He insists that assassins must never have friends.

Illumi steps forward and unleashes a suffocating, lethal bloodlust across the arena. He ruthlessly challenges Killua to fight him to protect his best friend. Illumi exploits years of brutal childhood conditioning, reminding Killua of the family rule to never challenge a superior opponent. Killua shakes uncontrollably in sheer panic.

Crushed by overwhelming psychological dread, Killua's spirit completely shatters. His eyes lose all light as he bows his head and surrenders without throwing a single strike. The chilling psychological trap claims victory, leaving Killua trapped in profound despair.
